name: word_count
description: Count lines, words, and characters in one workspace file
command: import json,pathlib,sys; a=json.load(sys.stdin); t=pathlib.Path(a['path']).read_text(); print(f"lines={len(t.splitlines())} words={len(t.split())} chars={len(t)}")

args_schema.path: file path relative to the workspace
